theme_central: Allah's blessings (ni'mah) as a cumulative proof of His Oneness — in the sky, the earth, livestock, fruits, and down to the bee, which gives the surah its name.
sources_note: Parts 1-2 (1-25, 26-89) sourced (grokipedia, detailed categories of blessings). The rest (90-128) reconstructed from very well-known landmarks: the verse of justice 16:90, the final verse on patience 16:128.

branches.title: Introduction: impatience vs blessings
branches.resume: Response to the disbelievers' impatience demanding punishment, opening of the long list of blessings.

children.t: Response to impatience demanding punishment; creation of the heavens, livestock, roads
Water, plants, day and night, mountains as signs
Comparison between the Creator and that which creates nothing

branches.title: The fate of the plotters, human messengers
branches.resume: Humiliation of ancient plotters, the angels' reception, confirmation that the messengers are men.

children.t: Fate of ancient plotters, the angels' reception of the pious and the disbelievers
Awaiting sudden punishment, reaffirmation of the resurrection
Emigration rewarded, confirmation that the messengers are men

branches.title: Warning, infanticide denounced
branches.resume: Everything bowing down before Allah, the contempt for daughters denounced, the water that revives the earth.

children.t: Warning against sudden punishment, universal prostration
Man's ingratitude, the contempt for daughters (infanticide) denounced
If Allah punished immediately, nothing would remain; the water that revives the earth

branches.title: The blessings in detail
branches.resume: Milk from livestock, fruits, the honey of the bee (the surah's namesake), houses and clothing.

children.t: Milk from livestock, fruits, the honey of the bee as healing
Old age, unequal provision, the parable of the slave and the generous free man
Knowledge of the unseen, the blessings of houses, clothing, shade

branches.title: Scene of Judgment, justice and commitments
branches.resume: Every nation with its witness; the verse of justice and kindness; honouring one's commitments.

children.t: Every nation with its witness, the Prophet a witness for his community
"Allah commands justice, kindness, and giving to relatives"
Honouring one's commitments, refuge in Allah against Satan

branches.title: Refutation, Ibrahim as model, closing
branches.resume: Refutation of the accusation of fabrication, the parable of the ungrateful city, Ibrahim as a model, a call to wisdom.

children.t: Refutation of the accusation of fabrication, the case of forced apostasy
The parable of the ungrateful city (security then famine), lawful and unlawful food
Ibrahim, a model community (umma) in himself, his path to follow
The Sabbath instituted, a call to wisdom and fine exhortation, final patience
